name: Seeking Spark
description: Fires a weak homing spark for 3 base arcane damage. Requires a visible enemy within 40 blocks; terrain blocks it.

name: Ricochet Pebble
description: Flings a pebble for 3 base blunt damage. Falls under gravity and ricochets up to three times off terrain, losing some speed with each bounce. Stops on its first enemy hit. Maximum travel 96 blocks or 10 seconds.

name: Dry Spell
description: Clears current wetness on an ally, otherwise yourself. Rain and immersion can make you wet again; this does not heat you or grant wetness immunity.

name: Returning Orb
description: Sends out an orb that returns toward you, dealing 2 base arcane damage per enemy on each leg. Up to three distinct enemies, each once per leg. Terrain stops it.

name: Cinder Wisps
description: Summons three orbiting wisps, each firing for 2 base fire damage at an enemy within 6 blocks. Launches are 0.75 seconds apart. Wisps expire after 15 seconds; recasting replaces the old set.

name: Conjure Buckshot
description: Fires eight 2-damage blunt pellets, up to 16 base point-blank damage. Severe falloff beyond 2 blocks. Hits at 8-9 blocks deal no damage and make a party-blower sound and confetti.

name: Starshot
description: Staff channel: hold for 1-4 base seconds, then release a star for 2-8 base arcane damage. Costs 8 base mana per second of charge, 8-32 total. Interrupted charge mana is spent; scroll casting is not supported.

name: Prayer of Mending
description: Places a charm on an ally or yourself. After a damaging hit, heals 3 base HP and jumps to another ally within 8 blocks. Five charges across the chain, at most once per second; expires after 30 base seconds without resetting on jumps.

name: Lifegrip
description: Pulls an ally toward you, stopping at obstructions. A successful pull makes the recipient immune to all Lifegrips for 10 seconds. No caster cooldown; an immune target does not cost mana.

name: Mending Circle
description: Places a 4-block-radius circle for 12 seconds. Each second, one total base HP is split among injured allies inside, including you. Full-health allies do not take a share. One active circle per caster.

name: Party Foul
description: Enemy: costs 100 base mana, prevents up to 15 total outgoing damage or lasts 4 seconds, whichever ends first; 20-second hostile cooldown. Ally/self: costs 10 base mana, adds cosmetic effects for 10 minutes without changing damage. More damage means livelier party-blower sounds and confetti.

name: Snapcast
description: Casting stance: +80% cast speed, -20% spell damage, +10% mana cost at normal potency. Buff potency modestly improves benefits and reduces penalties, with capped scaling. Only one stance; recast to turn off instantly and freely.

name: Furtive Caster
description: Casting stance: -25% mana cost and -25% cast speed at normal potency. Buff potency modestly improves savings and reduces the speed penalty, with capped scaling. Only one stance; recast to turn off instantly and freely.

name: All In
description: Casting stance: +30% spell damage, -25% cast speed, +20% mana cost at normal potency. Buff potency modestly improves damage and reduces penalties, with capped scaling. Only one stance; recast to turn off instantly and freely.
